items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: We had a fellow in the group, came with me, (Art Barney) and he -- name, Frank Andrew, and we called him Jew Baby

ctx.x: So he didn't go with the band, and I went with the band, but (unintelligible) with Mamie Smith. We had a fellow in the group, came with me, (Art Barney) and he -- name, Frank Andrew, and we called him Jew Baby, but he was -- his father was Italian, or Italian and father's mother (unintelligible) colored because his father was a drummer down in the Lincoln Theater, where Fats Waller used to play (unintelligible) organ all the time.
And we used to call him Jew Baby. We nicknamed him Jew Baby because he looked --
